markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (86%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Degraded simulated frozen-section quality, backbone disagreement, and InSitu-versus-Invasive ambiguity support deferring margins to permanent sections [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 86%, InSitu 14% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Favors invasive over in situ |
| Conformal set | {InSitu, Invasive} at 90% target (90% coverage) [F1] | Cannot exclude in situ carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 98th percentile OOD (AUROC 0.70) [F6] | Suspect degraded JPEG frozen input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%), 1/5 InSitu (BACH_0155) [F5] | Mostly invasive; InSitu neighbor close |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.04); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 7) · context · Below-typical (-0.46); separates case from InSitu BACH_0155 [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Typical score (+0.37); 0/20 AI spot check, unreliable [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 8) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.31); 18/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random (+1%, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation and simulated frozen-section artifacts (98th percentile OOD) mimic invasion, causing CONCH and MUSK to disagree.
- Carcinoma is duct-confined (InSitu, 14%), matching contrast case BACH_0155 (82% similarity, differing in TILs and duct confinement).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 5, 6, 9**: Verify stromal invasion (91%–98% risk) versus artifact; consider drafted recut and deeper levels.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 8**: Assess nuclear pleomorphism and verify whether atypical cells remain duct-confined (region 2 risk 26%).
3. **Regions 7, 11**: Inspect region 11 ducts/stroma and region 7 TILs; defer margin call to permanents.
